paired_difference: ablation minus full reference on the same realized calendar date
boundary_adjustment: cash - 0.45 * (end SOC - start SOC); common evaluation value, not the tested nu
positive_only_p95: the same linear quantile restricted to paired differences > 1e-5 yuan; absent when no adverse days
top_5percent_mean: arithmetic mean of largest ceil(0.05*n) observations; 17 observations for n=334
expected_scenario_risk: chosen candidate min(G_net) over the causal historical scenarios at that decision; projected, not realized
realized_risk: descriptive daily cash/emergency tails and realized paired adverse dates in this 2025 replay
comparability: per-policy decision states and candidate curves can differ; historical scenario min gains are not identical-state matched contrasts
scope: retrospective fixed-configuration diagnostics on previously used 2025 data; no independent or future-year guarantee; no automatic retuning
